svg.aria-label: Receipt Reader: Photo in, structured receipt out, in about 0.25 s. OpenCV cleanup → GPU PaddleOCR → LayoutLMv3 fields and line items → spending categories. SROIE field F1 0.65 → 0.83; fully-correct receipts 44% → 61%. Multi-agent error analysis caught 4 training-label bugs, each fix tested in its own worktree. Stack: PyTorch, LayoutLMv3, PaddleOCR, FastAPI, React.
